description: Signs on to the FirstCore portal, opens Account Servicing » Fee Management, inquires on the supplied account identifier, and waives (reverses) the assessed overdraft fee, returning the host reversal confirmation number. Classifies no-record accounts, closed accounts (waiver rejected), transient host congestion, and manager-override security interceptions.

extracts.name: confirmation_message
extracts.regex: (Fee FEE-\d+ reversed\. Credit of [\d,]+\.\d{2} posted to account \S+\. Confirmation RVSL-\d+)

escalate.reason: Security interception raised during sign-on; manager override PIN required.

when.value: No records found for the supplied account identifier.

business_outcomes.note: Observed with account 77777 — inquiry returns no account/fee data; flow stops, no waive possible.

when.value: HOST-0521: Legacy host link congested. Resubmit inquiry.

recoverable.note: Observed with account 55555: banner appeared on the first two Execute Inquiry attempts, succeeded on the third. Re-click #ext-gen44 in wrkFrm>modFrm.

escalate.reason: Manager Override PIN modal injected into the top document during inquiry.

when.value: Error: Account is closed. Fee waiver not permitted.

business_outcomes.note: Observed with account 99999 (STATUS CLOSED): the waive post is rejected by the host; no reversal is made.

when.value: SECURITY INTERCEPTION: Manager Override PIN Required

escalate.reason: Restricted-party waive triggers a blocking Manager Override PIN modal in the TOP document (#ext-gen95 / #ext-gen99_pin / Authorize #ext-gen101). A human with override authority must clear it; the reversal state is unknown until then.

robustness_notes: All ids are ExtJS-generated (ext-genNN) and are the only stable handles this build exposes; they were consistent across every screen load in this session, but they are the most likely thing to drift across vendor releases. Fallbacks worth encoding: the account field also has name='acctNbr' (input[name='acctNbr']); the inquiry and waive buttons carry unique visible text ('Execute Inquiry', 'Waive Fee'). Frame structure: top → hdrFrm / navFrm / wrkFrm, with the module injected into the nested wrkFrm>modFrm several seconds after clicking the nav item — always wait for #ext-gen42_input to exist. The nav tree starts collapsed: 'Account Servicing' must be expanded by clicking the +/- toggle span (#ext-gen89); clicking the group label div (#ext-gen88) alone did not expand it, and Fee Management is not clickable while collapsed. Two distinct busy indicators share id #loading-spinner inside wrkFrm>modFrm ('Legacy host communication in progress...' for inquiry, 'Posting reversal to host...' for the waive) — always wait for state=absent before reading results. The security override modal escapes the module frame and is rendered in the TOP document. The flow waives the single assessed fee row shown (OVERDRAFT ITEM FEE); if a future account lists multiple fee rows there will be multiple 'Waive Fee' controls and the row selection would need to be made explicit.
